name: com.halowerk/energy-research-hub
title: HALOWERK EU Power Dispatch API
description: EU power dispatch for compute, DePIN, battery and trading agents. Paid per call, x402 USDC.

tools.name: buy_dispatch_plan
tools.description: Schedules a deadline-bound compute, DePIN, battery or power-trading workload into an actionable German or European power window. Returns exact timing, expected EUR cost and savings, uncertainty, freshness, expiry and decision trace.

tools.name: buy_market_brief
tools.description: Returns licensed ENTSO-E and SMARD spot-market context for compute, DePIN, battery and power-trading agents: published day-ahead prices, volatility, load, renewable share when available, the observed share of published negative-price hours, uncertainty, freshness and expiry.

tools.name: research
tools.description: GET fallback with a machine-readable 402 response for POST /research.

tools.name: articles_id
tools.description: GET fallback with a machine-readable 402 response for POST /articles/{id}.

tools.name: tasks
tools.description: GET fallback with a machine-readable 402 response for POST /tasks.

tools.name: research_post
tools.description: Returns aggregated energy research for Germany and the EU from live data sources.

tools.name: demo_paid_sample
tools.description: Cheapest end-to-end x402 purchase test. Always returns a 402 challenge without payment and the current full NegPrice decision after a valid USDC payment.

tools.name: energy_decision
tools.description: EV, battery, and flexible-load agents buy this endpoint to receive an executable action with timing, expected value, confidence, and expiry.

policy_profile.description: Optional override. Trading defaults to precision; flexible devices default to utility.

tools.name: research_quick
tools.description: Research and market-monitoring agents buy this endpoint to answer a focused question with a compact live market snapshot.

tools.name: articles_id_post
tools.description: Returns the full text of one energy trade article; article ids and titles come from the free GET /articles catalog.

tools.name: tasks_post
tools.description: Asynchronous deep-dive task with a minimum bounty.

tools.name: price_spot
tools.description: Trading and dispatch agents buy this endpoint to obtain the current German EPEX spot price for immediate decisions.

tools.name: price_forecast
tools.description: Energy-trading and flexible-load agents buy this endpoint to compare the next 24 hours of EPEX prices and volatility.

tools.name: carbon_now
tools.description: Current CO2 intensity of the German electricity mix.

tools.name: grid_load
tools.description: Grid-monitoring and dispatch agents buy this endpoint to obtain the latest German system load from SMARD.

tools.name: renewable_share
tools.description: Carbon-aware and ESG agents buy this endpoint to measure the current renewable share and generation mix in Germany.

tools.name: flexibility_window
tools.description: EV, heat-pump, and flexible-load agents buy this endpoint to identify the cheapest upcoming operating hours.

tools.name: signals_buy_sell
tools.description: Energy price indicators for German day-ahead electricity prices: position of the current hour in the 24-hour range (RSI-style, 0-100), Z-score against the 7-day average, trend between the first and second 12 hours in ct/kWh, renewable pressure and fossil share, summed into a composite score with a descriptive relative-price label. Descriptive market statistics only, no trading recommendation and no investment advice.

tools.name: bundle_trading
tools.description: Energy-trading agents buy this endpoint to receive an eight-source market bundle with key metrics, insights, and raw evidence.

tools.name: history_prices
tools.description: Returns hourly EPEX day-ahead electricity prices for Germany for one period.

tools.name: history_prices_stats
tools.description: Returns statistics (minimum, maximum, mean and distribution) of German day-ahead electricity prices for one historical period.

tools.name: subscribe_price_alert
tools.description: Webhook subscription for electricity price thresholds.

tools.name: subscribe_co2_low
tools.description: Returns a webhook subscription that notifies your URL when the CO2 intensity of the German electricity mix falls below your threshold.

tools.name: optimizer_cheapest_window
tools.description: Flexible-load agents buy this endpoint to schedule a contiguous operating window at the lowest average electricity price.

tools.name: price_negative_forecast
tools.description: Hours with negative electricity prices in the next 24 hours.

tools.name: predict_negative_price
tools.description: Battery, EV, and trading agents buy this endpoint to receive calibrated 2h/4h/6h negative-price probabilities, reviewed threshold profiles and an executable response policy.

policy_profile.description: Selects the reviewed probability threshold profile without changing the underlying calibrated probabilities.

tools.name: summary_today
tools.description: Token-efficient daily summary with a concrete recommended action.

tools.name: region
tools.description: Returns electricity price, CO2 intensity, renewable share and weather for one German postal code region.

tools.name: events_grid
tools.description: Returns a grid event feed for Germany: dark doldrums (low wind and solar), storms, negative electricity prices and records.
